notes.title: Celebrating the silent message
notes.notes:
It is with great honor that we would like to announce that Endling – Extinction is Forever has won the awards for "Most Significant Impact" and "Game of the Year" at this year's Games for Change Awards. This event celebrates the people, projects, and organizations that have set out to make a meaningful difference. This year marked not only the 20th anniversary of Games for Change but today is also the first anniversary of Endling's release, making these awards the best birthday present we could have imagined.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33205595/227f68b821bdc3f4e3d1afade975e28c5d318f11.png[/img]

Yes, it's been one year already since Endling – Extinction is Forever was first released, and what a year it has been. More than the many accolades bestowed upon our game, the genuine responses by the players who were moved by the heart-wrenching tale of our mother fox and her cubs made it all worthwhile. Knowing that we were able to touch the hearts and minds of people is the most significant award of all.

[previewyoutube=JDZgNMfl4dU;full][/previewyoutube]

Bringing awareness to a dire situation through a different perspective, not by lecturing, is where the true success of Endling lies. No words were required to convey the message, only emotions we all share in the face of a possible future. As long as we can feel empathy for the struggles of the world around us, there is always hope for a better tomorrow.

notes.title: PS Plus July includes Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War and Alan Wake Remastered
notes.notes:
Sony has confirmed July's PlayStation Plus Essential games, and they include Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, Alan Wake: Remastered, and Endling: Extinction is Forever.

Confirmation of the games comes after Billbilkun on Dealabs, a leaker with a reliable track record, outed the contents earlier today.

First up comes Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, regarded among many in the long-time Call of Duty fanbase as a decent entry in the series history. It'll be coming to the service for both the PS4 and PS5, packed with one of the best campaigns in recent memory as well as a decent multiplayer FPS experience that is sure to get some life injected into it thanks to its appearance on PS plus.

notes.title: ENDLING - Extinction is Forever wins BAFTA Game Beyond Entertainment Award
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that Endling - Extinction is Forever has won the prestigious BAFTA Award for Game Beyond Entertainment at the 2023 BAFTA Games Awards. The game, developed by Herobeat Studios and published by HandyGames, was recognized for its compelling narrative and thought-provoking exploration of environmental issues.

[previewyoutube=pnw7oNcSIPk;full][/previewyoutube]

"We are honored to receive this recognition from BAFTA for Endling," said Christopher Kassulke, CEO of HandyGames. "We believe that games have the power to explore important issues and inspire players to make a positive impact in the world. We hope that Endling encourages players to think critically about humanity's impact on the environment and the importance of protecting the natural world for future generations."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33205595/04b681d9e0614b29806b13b128d632081f3c1551.png[/img]

The BAFTA Games Awards celebrate the very best games of the past year and the people who made them, showcasing a wide range of storytelling and creative excellence. The Game Beyond Entertainment category recognizes games that go beyond pure entertainment and explore important themes and issues.

notes.title: Thank You!
notes.notes:
[i]Endling - Extinction is Forever[/i] has been out there for a while now and your feedback and reviews have been overwhelming! Thank you all so much. Creating and selling games is a business first and foremost. This is no secret. Yes, we're in it because it is our passion, but we believe in calling a spade a spade. We're a company and companies need to turn a profit.

However, on a personal level, me, writing this, and every single one of my friends and colleagues at HandyGames, Herobeat Studios, and all our partners, get most excited about all the wonderful reactions from you, the players.

What drives us is people connecting with the game. These connections always happen on an emotional level. Be it the feeling of accomplishment for beating a difficult stage, good old fun times with friends, or in the case of [i]Endling - Extinction is Forever[/i], hopelessness and heartache towards the overwhelming odds that our fox family has to overcome.

[previewyoutube=JDZgNMfl4dU;full][/previewyoutube]

For this, we want to say: Thank you!
Thank you for laughing, crying, hoping, and despairing with us. It means more than you might imagine.

If you want to talk about your experience with this or any of our other games, please feel free to reach out. Steam reviews are always welcome, but you can also hop on our [url=discord.gg/handygames]Discord[/url] or join our Inside HandyGames live show on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/handygames_official]Twitch[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/handygames]YouTube[/url] every other week to get to know us on a more personal level and ask us anything you'd like to know.

Until then, thank you for spending your valuable time with, and hard-earned money on our games!

Have a fantastic day!

Consti (HandyGames)

notes.title: Endling - Extinction is forever coming soon!
notes.notes:
​According to a recent survey of 400 biologists conducted by New York's American Museum of Natural History, nearly 70% believe that the Earth is currently in the early stages of human-caused mass extinction. One biologist estimated that if current rates of human destruction of the biosphere continue, one-half of all plant and animal species of life on earth will be extinct in 100 years.
​Today, more than 28,000 animal species on our planet are threatened with extinction. Thousands of species - rhinos, lions, tigers, seals, and bears - are jeopardized by pollution, illegal poaching, wars, and the ever-increasing loss of their natural habitats.

Now imagine that humanity has driven one of the most adaptable creatures in the animal kingdom - the fox - to extinction. As the last fox on Earth, you are fighting for survival in search of the rare sources of food which are left in a dying world. But you are not searching for food for yourself alone. Your clumsy cubs are waiting eagerly for your return in the safety of the shelter. Until that faithful day, when something or someone wakes one of the young foxes…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33205595/00ab42a79805c02ceb75b28b40c961928fbe3f2f.png[/img]

Can you give this Endling a last glimmer of hope?

We will not be able to release "Endling - Extinction is forever" this Spring because we want you to have the best possible version of the game. It is going to be awesome. Thus, we have to postpone the release a tiny bit. We promise:

Endling - Extinction is forever is coming very soon!

​To make up for it, we decided - as some voices from the community already suggested - to have a boxed retail version of the game. We use a more eco-friendly cardboard box with fewer plastics for the PC-version. ​

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33205595/b0a4d4e1aab34f3c32a5ebd4db402f529289dbe3.png[/img]

notes.title: Endling is a game about a mama fox protecting her cubs in a human-ravaged world
notes.notes:
Endling is going to break my heart. It's a game about a mama fox trying to look after her pups in an unpleasant future where forests are being destroyed, pollution is rife and these poor animals have been hunted to near-extinction. It's sad, because it really doesn't seem to distant a future from real life, but that's kind of the point. Endling looks gorgeous and poignant, the sort of game that seems important to play, even if it does break my heart.

notes.title: ENDLING: BEST VIDEO GAME - CARTOON AWARD 2018
notes.notes:
ENDLING: BEST VIDEO GAME - CARTOON AWARD 2018

Back from 3D WIRE! Exhausted after almost one week of networking and speeches about video games and animation. The organisation was excellent and can't imagine how the event could be better. We will come back next year for sure!

We met amazing people there coming from many countries, sharing their experiences, and also could see old friends pitching their awesome projects.

The icing on the cake was winning the award to the BEST VIDEO GAME 3DWIRE 2018 out of 39 games selected, and free tickets for the Cartoon Media Festival 2019 (France). This is the first award Endling gets and I am sure it won't be the last.

Thank you very much to all the team Herobeat Studios for the hard work and to our followers for your support!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33205595/d79947a69ee4c9a2f52434b5457ce9414df5df4f.jpg[/img]
